title: Energy-Flow Cosmology, Part 2: Field Equations and Observable Mapping (µ, Σ, S8)
abstract: Derives the field equations of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) from an entropy-gradient principle, defines the entropy field S(a) and its coupling to the effective gravity parameters µ(k, z) and Σ(k, z), and maps these to observables fσ8, S8, and a regime response surface. The paper presents sealed blind predictions and reports consistency checks against DES Y6, KiDS-1000, DESI DR2, and BOSS DR12, while documenting an erratum that corrects the growth-ODE friction term without affecting reported numerical results.
